IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Health Care (originally sponsored by Senators Becker and Kohl-Welles)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of health to develop and make available resources for pregnant women regarding childhood immunizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing information regarding childhoodimmunizations to pregnant women; and adding a new section to chapter43.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall develop and make available resources forpregnant women regarding recommended childhood immunizations. Theresources are intended to be provided to pregnant women by their healthcare providers to encourage discussion on childhood immunizations andpostnatal care.
